tools.name: Exact Li finite-prefix false-positive calibration
tools.abstraction: Plant a functional-equation/conjugation-symmetric off-critical quartet and evaluate its Li transform exactly to test whether a proposed RH argument mistakes finite-prefix positivity for the all-index criterion.
preconditions: the target argument uses Li-type coefficient positivity or a finite-index surrogate
a synthetic symmetric zero multiset is a legitimate known-answer calibration for the claimed logical implication
tools.operation: construct Q={rho,conj(rho),1-rho,1-conj(rho)}, map z=1-1/rho, and compute Lambda_n(Q)=4-2 Re(z^n+z^-n) exactly over a requested finite range
guaranteed_effects: detects whether a finite-prefix Li claim survives an explicit off-critical symmetric known-answer case
provides exact sign decisions without numerical-roundoff authority
non_guarantees: does not model the full arithmetic structure of the actual zeta zero set
does not prove any actual zeta zero is off the critical line
does not refute Li's all-n criterion
does not establish that every finite-prefix RH argument is invalid when extra zeta-specific uniform structure is proved
validation_obligations: verify the quartet is off-critical and closed under conjugation and rho->1-rho
verify the exact z transform and reciprocal symmetry
use exact rational arithmetic for sign decisions
state the finite checked range and forbid extrapolation to the actual zeta zero set

tools.name: Root-bridge stability audit
tools.abstraction: Before strengthening a surrogate/local/finite certificate, freeze the exact passage to the root quantity and try to construct the cheapest family on which the surrogate premise remains valid while the root-normalized conclusion collapses.
preconditions: a precise surrogate object and surrogate certificate are defined
the target root quantity or implication and the surrogate-to-root lift/limit/assembly map are explicitly defined
a target-specific DifferenceWitness states why the source calibration and target failure mode are structurally comparable and mathematically different
structural_signature: surrogate certificate is locally or finite-scale valid
root conclusion requires an additional lift, limit, normalization, compactness, integrality, realization, or assembly step
the missing preservation property can be stated quantitatively or as an exact logical implication
tools.operation: write the tuple (surrogate, certificate, root object, bridge map, preservation property), then search for the cheapest exact sequence/family satisfying the surrogate premises while violating the root-normalized conclusion; if found, retire the weak bridge and record the minimum strengthened obligation
guaranteed_effects: an exact counterexample proves that the stated surrogate premises alone are insufficient for the stated root conclusion
a successful falsifier localizes the next proof obligation to a target-specific preservation/uniformity/faithfulness condition rather than further surrogate optimization
non_guarantees: does not prove that the actual target theory realizes the adversarial sequence
does not prove the strengthened bridge condition
does not identify a universal common obstruction across Millennium problems
does not create theorem, novelty, independent-review, or root-solution authority
validation_obligations: preserve units and normalization of the target root quantity
state order of limits and all uniformity domains
separate a counterexample to an inference form from a counterexample inside the target theory
provide a fresh DifferenceWitness for every cross-domain reuse
record the weakest surviving bridge statement after falsification
